descriptions.w3d_sound_manager_stop_category: Appears to stop every sound emitter whose sample belongs to a given category and release the voice playing it.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_always_true: Returns 1 unconditionally; likely a default capability query for sound emitters.
descriptions.w3d_sound_manager_create_with_sound: Creates a new sound emitter in the manager and attaches the given sample to it.
descriptions.w3d_sound_manager_create_emitter_ref: Creates an emitter with the next free id, attaches a sample and stores a referenced pointer in the caller's slot.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_not_implemented_801e02: Returns the 'not implemented' result code; a stub sound interface method.
descriptions.w3d_sound_manager_forget_sound: When a sample is unloaded, detaches it from all emitters and halts and resets any voice still using it.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_set_volume: Clamps the requested volume to the allowed range, stores it on the emitter and reports success.
descriptions.w3d_sound_manager_remove_801e0794: Stops the voice playing an emitter id and removes that emitter from the manager's emitter list.
descriptions.w3d_sound_manager_set_voice_position_801: Finds the voice assigned to an emitter id and passes it a new position; returns whether a voice was found.
descriptions.w3d_sound_manager_set_voice_mode_801e08f: Finds the voice assigned to an emitter id and passes it a new mode value; returns whether a voice was found.
descriptions.w3d_sound_manager_stub_801e0960: Placeholder sound manager setter that always reports failure.
descriptions.w3d_sound_manager_stub_801e0968: Placeholder sound manager getter that always reports failure.
descriptions.w3d_sound_manager_stub_801e0970: Placeholder sound manager setter that always reports failure.
descriptions.w3d_sound_manager_stub_801e0978: Placeholder sound manager vector setter that always reports failure.
descriptions.w3d_sound_manager_stub_801e0980: Placeholder sound manager vector setter that always reports failure.
descriptions.w3d_sound_manager_stub_801e0988: Placeholder sound manager vector getter that always reports failure.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_not_implemented_801e09: Returns the 'not implemented' result code; a stub sound interface method.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_destroy: Sound emitter destructor: releases the attached sample, tears down the base node and optionally frees the memory.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_start: Marks the emitter as playing from the start if it has a sample; otherwise returns a nonzero code.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_deactivate: Clears the emitter's playing flag if the sound system exists and the emitter is active; otherwise reports failure.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_resume: Decrements the emitter's pause depth if it is positive.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_is_audible: Returns whether the emitter has a sample, is playing and is not paused.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_is_vector_property: Returns whether a property id falls in the ranges 1-4 or 8-12; likely the properties this emitter supports.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_set_int: Sets an integer emitter property (mode and two manager-forwarded values); reports failure for unknown ids.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_set_vector: Sets the emitter position, velocity or direction and forwards the change to the sound manager.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_get_int: Reads an integer emitter property such as the mode or the sample's base rate; reports failure otherwise.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_get_float: Reads the emitter volume or the sample position at the current play cursor; reports failure otherwise.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_get_vector: Copies the emitter position or velocity, or asks the manager for the direction; reports failure otherwise.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_shutdown: Stops an active emitter and removes it from the sound manager; also compares its sample name with a loop sound.
descriptions.w3d_sound_system_get: Returns the global sound manager instance.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_detach_801e1120: Stops the emitter and releases its attached sample.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_vary_rate_801e1274: Returns a base rate randomly varied by a spread fraction, or the base rate unchanged when the spread is zero.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_advance: Advances the play cursor of a playing, unpaused emitter and stops it when a one-shot sample's channel has finished.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_get_attenuation: Returns the emitter's last computed distance attenuation.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_is_looping: Returns whether the attached sample loops, or 0 when no sample is attached.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_list_init: Clears all 32 slots of an emitter priority list and resets its count and capacity.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_list_destroy: Releases every emitter held in a priority list and optionally frees the list.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_list_count: Returns the number of emitters in a priority list.
descriptions.w3d_sound_emitter_list_get: Returns the emitter stored at an index of a priority list.
